topic: Bitcoin's supply is capped at 21 million
hook: There will only ever be 21 million bitcoin.

scenes.narration: Bitcoin's supply is capped at 21 million coins.
New coins enter circulation as block rewards paid to miners.
Because the reward halves every 210,000 blocks, new supply slows over time.

cta: Want to explore how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check the link on my channel page.
title: Only 21 Million Bitcoin Will Ever Exist
description_body: Bitcoin's supply is capped at 21 million coins, and block rewards halve every 210,000 blocks.
